items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, gated-product exposure, and rights-dependent monetization; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth that preserves consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims substantiation, data provenance and rights, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive safeguards. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, keep external outreach unsent, retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked, and authorize only existing bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: compliance is a technical baseline only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown; open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings remain. Analytics has permission/freshness limitations; failed sources remain unknown, not zero. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable. Operations and security sweeps are unavailable, and accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any public-display, alert-expansion, affiliate, or advertising decision.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed and 4 remain open. No task is closable on current evidence. Open tasks are searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked. Missing evidence: current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance and rights; permitted storage, caching, display, retention, and alerts; attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising limits. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed pending data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior; next action is a repository and deployed data-flow/retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed pending deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review; next action is read-only configuration capture without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed pending log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures; next action is a read-only operator/vendor inventory identifying counsel-required gaps. No data-use item is clear or conditionally launchable.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked. Their scaffold or parked state, missing analytics, and failed or unreachable compliance evidence do not support public launch or monetization. Next evidence action for each site is a timestamped site-specific checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, compliance, analytics, monetization, and an explicit retain-parked or bounded-launch decision. Do not expose or monetize before completion.
